description: URL defense: screen up to 25 links in one call. Each link is followed safely server-side and gets a verdict (REAL / SUSPICIOUS / LIKELY SCAM), a warning score, and its top warning flags. Private/internal links are refused per item and invalid entries are reported per item — one bad entry never fails the batch. One screen counts as one atom.

subscriptionCode.description: Optional subscription code (Personal Pro / Team). The screen draws on the plan’s monthly atom allowance instead of the free daily atoms.

urls.description: The links to screen (1–25), each starting with http:// or https://.

name: screen_urls
title: Screen a list of links
